html:
G'oya

Hisobot ikki xil qatordan iborat: bo'limlar bo'yicha yig'indilar va bitta umumiy yig'indi. Ularni ikki alohida so'rov bilan hisoblab, UNION ALL bilan ustma-ust qo'yamiz. Qiyin joyi tartibda: 'Jami' oddiy matn, alifbo bo'yicha u bo'limlar orasiga tushib qoladi.

Yechim

SELECT department, total
FROM (
  SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS total, 0 AS sort_key
  FROM employees
  GROUP BY department
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Jami', COALESCE(SUM(salary), 0), 1
  FROM employees
) r
ORDER BY sort_key, department

Yordamchi sort_key ustuni bo'lim qatorlariga 0, jami qatoriga 1 beradi. Saralash avval shu ustun bo'yicha, keyin nom bo'yicha. Tashqi SELECT uni natijadan olib tashlaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Faqat ORDER BY department yozilsa, 'Jami' alifbo bo'yicha o'z joyiga tushadi. Namunada u 'IT' bilan 'Kadrlar' orasida chiqadi:

Noto'g'riSELECT department, SUM(salary) AS total FROM employees GROUP BY department
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Jami', COALESCE(SUM(salary), 0) FROM employees
ORDER BY department

ORDER BY CASE WHEN department = 'Jami' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri UNION ALL oxiriga yozib bo'lmaydi: to'plam amalidan keyingi ORDER BY faqat natija ustuni nomi yoki raqamini qabul qiladi, ifodaga ikkala baza ham xato beradi. Ifoda bilan saralash kerak bo'lsa, butun natijani hosila jadvalga o'rang.

Jadval bo'sh bo'lsa, SUM NULL qaytaradi. Shart esa 0 talab qiladi, shuning uchun COALESCE.

Dialektlar farqi

PostgreSQL'da jami qatorini GROUP BY ROLLUP o'zi qo'shadi. SQLite'da ROLLUP yo'q.

Faqat PostgreSQLSELECT COALESCE(department, 'Jami') AS department, COALESCE(SUM(salary), 0) AS total
FROM employees
GROUP BY ROLLUP (department)
ORDER BY GROUPING(department), department
